event_chain.summary: Shared council systems breached, method not disclosed

summary: On Nov 24 2025 the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea (RBKC) suffered a cyber attack on IT systems it owns and shares with Westminster City Council and Hammersmith and Fulham Council, forcing emergency plans and network/phone shutdowns. RBKC and Westminster later confirmed that data, including personal data of thousands of residents, had been accessed, copied and taken by unnamed attackers.
